source.name: Products
source.sourceDefinition:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Products]
(
    [ProductID] int IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    [ProductName] nvarchar(200) NOT NULL,
    [SKU] nvarchar(50) NOT NULL,
    [Price] decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
    [StockQuantity] int NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
    [CategoryID] int NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK__Products__B40CC6ED0E119479] PRIMARY KEY (ProductID),
    CONSTRAINT [UQ__Products__CA1ECF0DC5B9041E] UNIQUE (SKU),
    CONSTRAINT [FK__Products__Catego__412EB0B6] FOREIGN KEY (CategoryID) REFERENCES dbo.Categories (CategoryID)
);
